model.sequential.label: Sequential weekly planning
model.sequential.help: Plan consecutive weeks, carrying ending inventory and unfulfilled orders into the following week. Workload capacity is shared by plant and week. Use this model to explore supply across several weeks.
model.legacy.label: Independent-week analysis
model.legacy.help: Analyze each week separately within the selected period using quantity capacity. Inventory and unfulfilled orders do not carry into the next week. Use this model when you want independent weekly results.

display.07bbb4d6e202: Scheduled supply usable in the selected week. No matching rows means no scheduled external receipts for this selection.
display.9592ec368013: Published plant-week KPIs, not product-week KPIs. 0/0 ratios remain N/A; weekly fulfillment is the current-week cohort.

ui.run_controls.output_exists: The Independent-week output folder {path} already exists. Planning is disabled to protect its files. Choose a different intended date range only after confirming its output folder is unused.
planning.help.date_start: Both planning dates must be Sunday week-ending dates. The start must be on or before the end.
planning.help.date_end: Both planning dates must be Sunday week-ending dates. The end must be on or after the start.
planning.help.demand_basis: Use your uploaded demand plan or replay supplied historical demand. Neither option creates a forecast.
planning.help.assumption_version: Required non-empty label recorded with this input and assumption bundle; default: streamlit-user-upload-v1.
planning.help.quantity_step: Use 0 for continuous quantities. Use 5 to allocate production in multiples of 5, rounding down when needed. Default 0; minimum 0; no form maximum.
planning.help.surge: Demand of 100 becomes 110 with a 10% increase. Applies to Demand Surge and Combined Stress. Default 10%; minimum 0; no form maximum.
planning.help.disruption: Capacity of 100 becomes 80 with a 20% reduction, for selected plants in Capacity Disruption and Combined Stress. Default 20%; range 0–100%.
planning.help.plants: Select the plants whose capacity is reduced in disruption scenarios. The first uploaded plant is selected by default when available.
planning.help.backlog_policy: CARRY_FORWARD retains unserved obligations as backlog. LOST_SALES discards current-week unserved demand and requires zero opening backlog.
planning.help.quantity_unit: Fallback product quantity unit, used only when the uploaded product data does not provide a usable unit. Enter the actual unit; do not guess.
planning.help.priority: Priority applies when product priorities are absent and the explicit assumption is enabled. Options: 1 lower, 2 medium (default), 3 higher.
planning.help.factor: Synthetic workload per product quantity unit. Default 1.0; minimum 0.000001; step 0.25. This is an assumption, not a measured production standard.
planning.help.workload_unit: Unit used for workload factors and capacity; default EqWU. Factors and capacity must use compatible units.
planning.help.capacity_calibration: If capacity data is missing, explicitly estimate capacity from qualified demand. This is an assumption, not measured plant capacity.
planning.help.capacity_target: Target utilization used to derive synthetic workload capacity. Default 0.75; range 0.01–1.00; step 0.05.
workflow.prepare: Prepare Data — upload/map and explicitly validate inputs; planning requires its own action.
workflow.analyze: Analyze saved results — enter the completed Sequential Planning folder in the sidebar. You do not need to run planning again.
workflow.views: Overview: selected-scenario trends. Scenario Comparison: all-scenario KPI summary. Trade-off Analysis: an explicit Reference/Candidate pair, independent of the global scenario.
workflow.path: Enter the folder containing completed Sequential Planning results, including the planning record run_manifest.json. Ask the person who prepared it for the correct location.
workflow.global: Selected scenario for overview and risk investigation: {scenario}. Choose comparison scenarios separately.
workflow.handoff: Investigate {scenario} / {product}: open Planning Risk Summary → Root Cause Investigation.
display.raw: Raw technical data, machine statuses, user content, filenames and CSV contracts remain canonical. Wide tables may require horizontal scrolling.
diagnostic.summary: Details below are original technical messages; inspect the reported field, scope or reason.
diagnostic.policy: Policy contrast: zero backlog does not establish improved service.
priority.label: Priority {value}
metric.Production_Coverage_Rate.label: Production Coverage Rate
metric.Production_Coverage_Rate.help: Internal production / required production. Zero requirement is N/A.
metric.Demand_Fulfillment_Rate.label: Demand Fulfillment Rate
metric.Demand_Fulfillment_Rate.help: Use Fulfillment_Basis: current-week cohort or horizon-origin cohort; opening-origin service is excluded from horizon service.
metric.Horizon_Service_Level.label: Horizon Service Level
metric.Horizon_Service_Level.help: (Current fulfillment + fulfilled horizon-origin backlog) / qualified demand; excludes opening-origin service.
metric.Weekly_Service_Level.label: Weekly Service Level
metric.Weekly_Service_Level.help: Current-week fulfilled demand / current-week qualified demand; later backlog service is not current-week service.
metric.Terminal_Backlog.label: Terminal Backlog
metric.Terminal_Backlog.help: Terminal item endpoint stock, never a sum of weekly backlog stocks.
metric.Ending_Backlog.label: Ending Backlog
metric.Ending_Backlog.help: Ending backlog stock at the displayed grain. Zero LOST_SALES backlog is not improved service.
metric.Ending_Inventory.label: Ending Inventory
metric.Ending_Inventory.help: Terminal inventory stock in product units; never sum weekly stocks.
metric.Lost_Sales.label: Lost Sales
metric.Lost_Sales.help: Policy-defined unfulfilled quantity flow; separate from terminal backlog.
metric.Lost_Sales_Qty.label: Lost Sales Quantity
metric.Lost_Sales_Qty.help: Policy-defined loss flow, not terminal backlog.
metric.Allocated_Workload.label: Allocated Workload
metric.Allocated_Workload.help: Allocated equivalent workload; not product quantity.
metric.Unmet_Workload.label: Unmet Workload
metric.Unmet_Workload.help: Unmet workload at the native product or shared pool grain; not cohort capacity.
metric.Capacity_Utilization.label: Capacity Utilization
metric.Capacity_Utilization.help: Allocated / available workload in unique plant-week pools; zero capacity is N/A in sequential mode.
metric.Delta.label: Delta (Candidate − Reference)
metric.Delta.help: Use Delta_Unit. Service deltas are already percentage points; do not multiply by 100 again.
metric.Required_Production_Qty.label: Required Production Quantity
metric.Required_Production_Qty.help: Existing net production requirement; not raw demand or workload.
metric.Scenario_Qualified_Demand.label: Scenario Qualified Demand
metric.Scenario_Qualified_Demand.help: Scenario demand after explicit qualification and coverage.
metric.Fulfilled_Quantity.label: Fulfilled Quantity
metric.Fulfilled_Quantity.help: Existing horizon fulfillment numerator; excludes opening-origin service.
metric.Current_Unfulfilled_Quantity.help: Current-demand unfulfilled flow; not terminal backlog.
metric.Terminal_Opening_Backlog.label: Terminal Opening-origin Backlog
metric.Terminal_Horizon_Backlog.label: Terminal Horizon-origin Backlog
metric.Service_Level.label: Legacy Independent-week Service Level
metric.Service_Level.help: Legacy independent-week allocated quantity / net demand; keep the independent-week zero-denominator policy.
metric.Allocation_Rate.label: Allocation Rate
metric.Allocation_Rate.help: Independent-week allocated quantity / scenario demand, not sequential horizon service.
status.COMPARABLE.label: Comparable
status.COMPARABLE.help: Applicable metric checks passed; this does not select a winner.
status.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.label: Descriptive only
status.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.help: Read the reason; do not infer a fair improvement ranking.
status.BLOCKED.label: Blocked
status.BLOCKED.help: Unavailable comparison; never replace missing values with zero.
status.POLICY_CONTRAST.label: Policy contrast
status.POLICY_CONTRAST.help: Zero LOST_SALES backlog is not by itself improved service.
status.N/A.label: Not available / undefined
status.N/A.help: Inspect the denominator, grain and reason; N/A is not zero.
